analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($79.12) vs SMA5/20/50($78.36/$73.76/$71.57): Above short-term SMA5, above mid-term SMA20/50, indicating a strong position.
· Above SMA100/200($74.12/$63.05) by 6.75%/25.48%: Mid-to-long term trend strength is favorable.
· 52-week position (82.3%) + Current price is 10.08% below 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (62.3→60.9): Staying in neutral zone, cooling from overbought signal.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (1.1008→0.6346): Worsening, indicating weakening bullish momentum.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $73.76): Trading near the middle band, band width at 23.36% and expanding.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($70.96): Above 20-day low ($66.55), based on Pivot S1 ($70.07).
· Swing Resistance ($79.68): Breakout targets 5-day high ($80.06) and Bollinger upper band ($82.38).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Recovery signal, confirming uptrend maintenance.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.72x): Below 5-day average, moderate confidence in movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend): Entering early Higher Low pattern, 1x target allocation filled. Next card is leverage.
